anchors.value: the public has to engage and create a natural and healthy FOMO
real public engagement -> visible contributions and receipts from peers/normies -> others see people like them getting in and earning receipts -> natural FOMO -> more contributions
healthy means earned: no fake engagement, no bought reach, no hype or return promises (Harmonic Hacker doctrine); FOMO comes from verified participation, not claims

forecast: The normie show + public contribution receipts are the FOMO engine; each visible first contribution lowers the next person's intimidation
